title: Independent relaxation and bonding analysis of high-pressure cadmium melaminate
category: periodic solid-state structure and chemical bonding
difficulty_reasons: The crystal identity and observables are fixed, but the agent must independently select a defensible periodic relaxation and bonding-analysis route and map inequivalent C-N and Cd-N objects.

paper.title: Stabilization of Fully Deprotonated Melaminate Anions (C3N6)6– in M3(C3N6) (M = Cd, Ca)
paper.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

data.description: Self-contained CIF and structure manifest for the neutral R3c Cd3(C3N6) periodic cell at 47.7 GPa.

required_deliverables.description: Validated computational route, explicit object mappings, observables, limitations and conclusion.
